eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 11:39 AM on AUG 25, 2023 Effective until 11:39 AM AUG 26, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office has ordered a mandatory evacuation for the Bancroft community area due to wild fires. This notice affects all residents.  It is of utmost importance to get out now and evacuate south on 389 towards DeQuincy. Its important to get out now but please do it safely. Please evacuate the Bancroft community/areas. Use Hwy 389 south towards DeQuincy
